method: Assigned-seat checking with prior knowledge of user-authorized cafe attendance and two grade-level enquiries about a separate class.

exceptionContext.inquiryDurationDescription: User reports enquiries took little time; no duration supplied.

limitations: Second user-reported direct-performance record; exact observation date, instrument, timer operator and raw boundaries not supplied.
The user confirms cafe and class participants are distinct and non-checkers started study after seating.
School cafe attendance is separate from the user's zero off-campus-outing report; class location was not specified.
Six cafe students plus 24 class students gives 30 distinct reported context students, not a measured vacant-seat count or a verified attendance denominator.
Cafe attendance was already known through the user's prior authorization; preknowledge may affect timing comparability across checkers and sessions.
Two enquiries are grade-level events, not 30 individual enquiries. Their duration and interruptions were not timed.
No missed-student result or independently audited accuracy supplied for this session; the previous session's zero-missed claim is not transferred.
Checking elapsed time is not automatically total person-time or study-time gained. No personal names, signed records or individual attendance stored.
